suffer.line: And you did always say that one day I would suffer
stanza: And I am Laura now, and Laura still
And you did always say that one day I would suffer
Did always say that people get their pay
You did always say that I was going places
And that you wouldn't have it any other way

tougher.line: Good people suffer and the heart gets tougher
stanza: The world's on fire and we just climb higher
Till we're no longer bothered by the smoke and sound
Good people suffer and the heart gets tougher
